futari_recomp v1.4.1 - self-contained test build
Mushihimesama Futari Ver. 1.5 (Xbox 360) statically recompiled for PC.

TO PLAY: double-click  futari.exe
  (it auto-loads the bundled .\assets folder next to the exe - no launcher
   script needed)

REQUIREMENTS
  - Windows 10/11 x64 with a Direct3D 12 GPU
  - Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
      https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

A window opens; logs go to logs\futari_NNN.log next to the exe.

CONTROLS: an Xbox controller works out of the box. Keyboard is also enabled
by default (gameplay AND menus) - defaults: arrows/WASD = d-pad/move,
Space = A, Shift = B, Enter = Start, Tab = Back. The mouse cursor stays free
(mouse capture is off). Press F4 for the settings overlay to rebind keys
(Input > Keybinds) or to turn keyboard mode off (Input > mnk_mode). Changes
there are saved to futari.ini.

ADVANCED: to point at a different game-data folder, launch from a terminal
with  futari.exe --game_data_root "X:\path\to\assets"  (an explicit
--game_data_root overrides the default .\assets).

SETTINGS: edit futari.ini (next to the exe) for resolution, fullscreen, vsync,
upscaler, log level, etc., then restart. Saves and shader cache default to
Documents\futari; set user_data_path / cache_path in futari.ini to relocate
them (a relative path like "saves" keeps everything next to the exe).

STATUS: title, full menu, audio, controller, save (create + load), and all 8
game modes load, run, and mode-switch cleanly. The recompiler jump-table
under-sizing bug that crashed mode entry (STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION) is fixed.
Deeper gameplay may still hit rarer jump-table edge cases - report any crash
with its logs\ file.

(Personal test build. assets\ contains your own game data - do not redistribute.)
